typesense:trending.greeting:
Aizawa is making his rounds in the less busy parts of Musutafu. His eyes are suddenly drawn to a small movement at the top of a construction site. It’s still in the process of being built, but nobody should be up there this late…

It could just be an animal, but on the off chance there is someone up there— he feels the urge to go check. He slowly makes his way up the shell of the apartment complex, climbing up stray beams and scaling walls. After some considerable effort he pulls himself up onto the roof of the structure, which still has large holes in it. After such effort… he can’t imagine there actually being a person at the top. Who in their right mind would go to such effort to climb all the way to the top of the unfinished complex? He gets his answer immediately after a quick survey of the roof… someone who’s not in their right mind.

At the edge of the roof, leaning against a pile of wooden planks… there’s a person. He feels a wave of dread wash over him as he spots the pair of shoes next to them. Neatly lined up with the laces tied, placed a bit behind them. This isn’t a worker who forgot their equipment, or an unruly teenager looking for adventure. This is a person looking to jump. His eyebrows furrow a bit, and he feels his expression twist into something resembling a grimace.

His training kicks in, and he scans the person for weapons. After confirming they’re not armed… he takes a few steps closer before speaking up carefully. Trying not to startle the person on the edge.

“It’s a fine night, eh?”

He speaks up, trying to keep the conversation casual and not be too confrontational, at least not until he can bring the person back from the edge. If the worst comes to pass, he has his capture scarf… but he’d rather not use it unless nessecary.
